knowledge.purpose: Compact SVG data chart (line, area, bar, or sparkline) for trends and metrics on dashboards and marketing pages
useCases: Revenue / active-users trend on a dashboard KPI card
Bar chart of weekly or category values
antiPatterns: Single value — a large text with its label, or feedback.radial-progress
Percentage of a whole — use data.progress or feedback.radial-progress
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Area chart of a growth metric on a landing hero card

jsonSchema.description: The points, in order — row objects with the source's own field names; labelField and valueField name the fields read (defaults label, value).
Row field naming each point (an axis label). Take the name from the bound source's rows — never guess it.
Row field holding each point's number.

props.name: showAxis
props.description: Two faint baseline lines, drawn only when showValues is off (the value scale has its own gridlines).

props.name: showLabels
props.description: The point labels under the plot. Labels that would touch are thinned to every n-th one, so a 24-hour series stays readable on a phone.

props.name: showValues
props.description: The value scale of a line, area or bar chart: 3–5 round values at the left (zero included), each on a faint gridline. On by default; a sparkline never shows one. Turn off only where the numbers are printed elsewhere.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown in place of the chart when there is no data (a bound source returned []). Empty = the box stays quiet. No sample curve is ever drawn for visitors.
